html:
You move thick food products every day. Tomato paste creates a challenge because it flows slowly and requires strong pumping systems. A proper tomato paste transfer pump solves that problem. It moves dense paste without damaging product quality or stopping production.At RotoZest Industries, we manufacture reliable rotary gear pumps for food processing plants across India. You use our pumps to move viscous liquids such as tomato paste, sauces, syrups, oils, and concentrates.Our SS and CI rotary gear pumps deliver steady flow, strong pressure, and long service life. Food processors, packaging plants and bulk food manufacturers rely on these pumps for daily operations.

Why Tomato Paste Requires a Special Pump

Tomato paste contains high solids and thick consistency. Standard pumps struggle with this viscosity.

A tomato paste transfer pump handles these conditions because rotary gears push product through the chamber at a constant rate. The pump does not rely on high speed. Instead, it uses controlled displacement.

This design helps you:

  • Maintain steady product flow
  • Prevent clogging
  • Reduce product waste
  • Protect paste texture and quality

Food plants often combine liquid transfer pumps with gear pump systems to manage different stages of processing.

How Rotary Gear Pumps Transfer Tomato Paste

Rotary gear pumps use two interlocking, rotating gears. These gears form a group of product in between the gear teeth and push it out toward the discharge area.

The system delivers constant flow even with thick products.

Key advantages

  • Handles high viscosity products
  • Maintains steady pressure
  • Requires low maintenance
  • Works well with food-grade materials

This makes the tomato paste transfer pump a preferred option for food factories.

Food engineers often recommend gear pumps for paste and sauce transfer.

Dr. Rajiv Sharma, a food processing engineer, explains:

“Positive displacement pumps such as gear pumps remain the most reliable equipment for transferring high viscosity foods like tomato paste.”

Many processing plants install liquid transfer pumps alongside gear pumps to handle different liquid products during processing.

Our SS Rotary Gear Pumps for Food Applications

Stainless steel pumps work best in food production environments.

Our SS rotary gear pumps support hygienic processing and corrosion resistance.

Key Features

  • Food grade stainless steel construction
  • Smooth internal surfaces for easy cleaning
  • High pressure capability
  • Long operational life

You often use these pumps as a tomato paste transfer pump in:

  • Ketchup production lines
  • Sauce manufacturing plants
  • Tomato processing units
  • Food packaging systems

These pumps also function as reliable liquid transfer pumps when moving oils, syrups, juices, and liquid food ingredients.

CI Rotary Gear Pumps for Industrial Use

Cast iron gear pumps handle heavy-duty industrial transfer work.

Many factories use CI pumps where hygiene requirements remain lower but viscosity remains high.

Applications include:

  • Oil transfer
  • Chemical transfer
  • Heavy liquid pumping
  • Industrial fluid handling

These pumps also support liquid transfer pumps operations in bulk processing facilities.

Industrial plants rely on CI rotary pumps for strength, durability, and cost efficiency.

Rotary Gear Pump Suppliers in India

India’s manufacturing sector continues to expand. The Indian industrial pump market grew 6.2% in 2024, according to industry data from the India Brand Equity Foundation.

You need reliable pump suppliers who understand industrial fluid transfer.

RotoZest Industries supplies rotary gear pumps across major Indian states including:

(Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Bihar, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Himachal Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh etc…)

As experienced rotary gear pump suppliers in India, we support food processors, chemical plants, and industrial manufacturers.

Many tomato processing plants rely on our systems as a tomato paste transfer pump for continuous production.

Tomato Processing Applications

Tomato paste production requires reliable pumping at several stages.

You will often see a tomato paste transfer pump installed in:

Raw Processing

  • Tomato pulp transfer
  • Puree movement between tanks

Concentration Stage

  • Thick paste transfer to evaporation systems

Packaging Lines

  • Paste transfer to filling machines

Each stage requires steady pressure and accurate flow.

That is why food manufacturers choose rotary gear pumps for this job.

Why Food Manufacturers Choose Gear Pumps

You want equipment that runs every day without failure.

Rotary gear pumps provide several benefits.

Reliable flow

The pump maintains constant output even when viscosity changes.

Energy efficiency

The system works at lower speeds than many other pumps.

Reduced maintenance

Simple design means fewer components to repair.

Long service life

Industrial gear pumps run for years with proper maintenance.

This reliability makes them the preferred tomato paste transfer pump solution in many food plants.

FAQs

faq.q: What pump is best for transferring tomato paste?
faq.a: A rotary gear pump works best. It handles thick viscosity and maintains steady flow. Many food plants install a tomato paste transfer pump to move paste between processing tanks.

faq.q: Why do food factories use rotary gear pumps?
faq.a: These pumps move viscous liquids at constant pressure. They protect product texture and reduce production interruptions.

faq.q: Are stainless steel gear pumps safe for food processing?
faq.a: Yes. Stainless steel pumps meet hygiene standards and resist corrosion. Food manufacturers widely use them for sauce and paste transfer.

faq.q: Where are tomato paste transfer pumps used?
faq.a: You find them in tomato processing plants, sauce production units, ketchup manufacturing lines, and food packaging systems.

faq.q: Do gear pumps work for other liquids?
faq.a: Yes. These pumps also function as liquid transfer pumps for oils, syrups, chemicals, and industrial fluids.

faq.q: Who are reliable rotary gear pump suppliers in India?
faq.a: Manufacturers like RotoZest Industries supply industrial gear pumps to factories across India.
